title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement
subtitle: How model releases shape Reddit perceptions of conversational AI systems
abstract: Conversational AI systems continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts. This project studies Reddit discussions from October 2022 to December 2025 to show how model releases reshape sentiment, expectations, trust, access concerns, and public discussion themes.

release_stories.title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery
release_stories.summary: GPT-4o concentrates the paper's strongest expectation-gap signal; GPT-5 turns that accumulated attachment into backlash, while GPT-5.1 reduces the intensity of the revolt.

release_stories.title: Product-Model Fit
release_stories.summary: Claude 4 is the clearest positive release profile, with coding, automation, and Claude Code discussion replacing earlier failure-mode complaints.

release_stories.title: Demand Shock
release_stories.summary: R1 expands the discussion almost overnight: technical praise coexists with access failures, reliability concerns, and censorship discovery.

release_stories.title: Politicized Anthropomorphism
release_stories.summary: Grok 3 is read through model quality, provider identity, and political persona at the same time.
